title: General Directorate of Special Education Holds Workshop on Comprehensive Accessibility for Persons with Disabilities
summary: The General Directorate of Special Education, under the Ministry of Education, has organized a workshop focused on ensuring comprehensive accessibility for individuals with disabilities, aiming to enhance inclusive educational environments.
body:
The General Directorate of Special Education, under the Ministry of Education, has organized a workshop focused on ensuring comprehensive accessibility for individuals with disabilities, aiming to enhance inclusive educational environments.

title: Pingtung County Launches Trial Accessible Independent Living Experience Room
summary: The Social Affairs Bureau of Pingtung County opens a trial run of an accessible environment experience room where persons with disabilities can practice independent living.
sourceName: 屏東縣政府全球資訊網
